desc: Reformulate as signed-interval difference constraints and derive the pairwise conflict criterion
Implement the full solution (Fenwick XOR hashing + two-pointer + query answering)
Validate the criterion against brute-force feasibility on small instances (exhaustive N≤6, random N=7,8, randomized end-to-end runs of `main()`)
Check edge cases: `L == R`, `b = a+2`, N = 3, BIT index bounds (`a+1`, `b ≤ N`)
Benchmark worst case (N=4·10^5, M=Q=2·10^5) and micro-optimize the hot Fenwick/two-pointer loops (merged query walk + merged point updates)
Verify the final optimized program reproduces Sample 1 (Yes/No) and Sample 2 (No/Yes/Yes) and re-run `--selftest` after the optimizations
Optional final polish (not needed: benchmarks within budget)
